claimChecks.environment: Upgrade order and Mission Control data migration
claimChecks.assessment: The versioned upgrade guide says the window extends when upgrading ES to 8.8 on Platform 10.6 or higher, with roughly five additional minutes per GB to move the Mission Control incidents collection from KV Store to PostgreSQL, subject to environment, volume and record count. It describes possible analyst-queue and service interruptions. Platform 10.5 or lower does not extend the ES upgrade window in this source; upgrading Platform to 10.6 or higher after ES 8.8 moves data in the background. Exact route applicability belongs to Release Watch.
